6754-7084-8227.notablePrerequisites:

141-413-1854.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-413-1854.description:
Cast Makeshift Mannequin by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it and Blasting Station trigger, with Naru Meha targeting Makeshift Mannequin.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Naru Meha, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Makeshift Mannequin
Resolve the Makeshift Mannequin copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

570-2608-3899-5542.manaNeeded: {1} if you don't control a black or red permanent
570-2608-3899-5542.description:
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{U}.

Choose to return Derevi from your graveyard to the command zone.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Activate Derevi by paying {1}{G}{W}{U}, putting it from the command zone onto the battlefield.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Faeburrow Elder.
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{U}.
Resolve the second Derevi trigger, untapping Faeburrow Elder.
Repeat.
570-2608-3899-5542.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any other permanent(s) using Derevi.

3259-3263-5953-7297.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.

Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

Repeat.
